publishedMetadata.title: Infinite queries
publishedMetadata.description: A practical TanStack Query 5 lesson teaching infinite queries using real React Query cache behavior and HTTP failure scenarios with separate starter and instructor assertions.
objectives: Paginate the real cursor API with useInfiniteQuery, a correct next-page parameter, and stale-cursor recovery.
Create 25 todo tasks; fetch pages 10+10+5 without duplicates. After adding a new task, the previous cursor should return 409 and the client should restart.
Bound displayed pages and total task payloads. Infinite query caches can grow without limits; trim or evict older pages when appropriate.
